exact_question: Under the pinned hillipop-ede_n3 source/configuration, the same fixed admitted common background and matched validated z=810 start state used by Q051, does the actual native CLASS/P6 low-z implementation produce q=xHeII=10^-6 versus q=0 electron-fraction and Thomson-optical-depth histories that are reproducible, trajectory-consistent with the literal source-real dynamics, and contained within Q051's uniform analytic bounds; and what are the realized sup|Delta x_e| and sup|Delta tau_T| with a validated numerical error certificate?
goal: Provide finite source-real observable-error enclosures for one nominal L/R realization on the whole 0<=z<=810 domain, or first precise implementation/input obstruction.

q_endpoints: exact 1/1000000 target versus captured binary64(1e-6); enclose the parameter conversion in residual/source uncertainty
frozen.background: same one fixed admitted member; parameter equality is not its validation receipt
frozen.initial_states: captured nominal h,D_Tmat per original start hex; define target IVP and exact v conversion explicitly

mathematical_model.additional_state: all other actually active variables in source; prove absent rather than drop silently
mathematical_model.field: y_prime=F_sigma(u,y;q,B), literal branch/equality and phase semantics
mathematical_model.optical_depth: tau_T(0,Z)=integral_0^Z w_B(z) X(z) dz with shared positive kernel

required_evidence.requirement: Full-state piecewise differentiable reconstruction with derivatives or finite coefficients and interval enclosures covering every segment, not only output-grid values.
required_evidence.minimal_capture: One nominal L/R pair; accepted state/phase points and sufficient dense representation. Raw h,D_Tmat, helium coordinate/q, source output X, phase and flags. Record auxiliary states if actually active.

required_evidence.requirement: Validated common B reconstruction/tube anchored to Q048/Q050 retained family, nH/H/eta and needed derivatives, or an existing checkable receipt covering this exact trajectory and interval.

Evaluate or prove absent all relevant literal guards: Pion/PION_MAX, Tmat/Trad=T_RATIO_MIN, Trad_phys=TR_MIN, SWIFT lower-fit cutoff, v=1, phase/output transitions. One-sided states, equality flags and source expressions; validated brackets/tubes, not sampled event labels alone.
Cover final saved z809.6825 to810; export straddling output cell and pre/post-intervention states, eta/kernel information, no unproved last-cell extrapolation.
Source constants, tables, floating-state interpretation, normalization, libm evaluations and residual evaluator need explicit enclosure error or validated interval evaluation.
Separate exact target initial condition from its captured/converted approximation and bound E0. Do not conflate nominal/refined different starts.

finite_algorithm: Verify immutable input/source/binary/config hashes; choose explicit target IVP and norm.
Build full-state reconstruction and admitted common-background enclosure over finite segments including terminal segment.
Prove each smooth-cell guard sign or isolate a validated event slab; retain possible event order/coincidence and exact equality semantics.
Enclose r=norm(yhat_prime-F_sigma(u,yhat;q,Bhat)), beta for background-field mismatch, and a for reconstruction/source arithmetic. All bounds must hold over whole tubes/cells.

Verify tube closure and propagate E by Gronwall/logarithmic-norm majorant on smooth pieces; handle event transition by separately validated map/flow bounds. No Lipschitz-across-discontinuity shortcut.
Enclose exact source output map and discrepancy to saved output interpolant; add L/R error budgets for Delta X.
Integrate positive same-background kernel error and quadrature/output-map errors for Delta tau. Include final interval; calculate continuous sup enclosures.
Check continuous upper bounds against Q051 envelopes only after all inherited premises validate. Report intervals at actual achieved accuracy; no invented negligibility target.
Return certificate receipts and source/state/event provenance or first finite exact failure.

propagation.event: Validated local transition bound; isolated transverse saltation only after hypotheses checked; endpoints/coincidences require appropriate finite-flow/tube analysis.
propagation.pair_output: e_pair<=e_X_L+e_X_R, including mismatch of G(yhat) to saved interpolant.
propagation.forbidden_shortcut: Q051 q-sensitivity coefficient is not automatically a general residual propagator.

tolerances.polynomial_enclosure_width_already_execu: 1e-16; applies only to serialized polynomial suprema
tolerances.source_real_accuracy: Report actual certified finite widths; requested no arbitrary new tolerance. Containment requires upper_x<=0.0023814 and upper_tau<0.0421 with all assumptions verified.

execution_minimum.new_native_runs: No unchanged rerun. If full state cannot be recovered, at most one newly instrumented nominal pair at this stage; no automatic four-level campaign.
execution_minimum.solver_internal_capture: NDF15 history/Jacobian/accepted-step caches only if needed by chosen proof; not mandatory for every residual method.
execution_minimum.new_trace_provenance: New run ID; cannot backfill missing internal history of40350424272 from matching observables.
execution_minimum.diagnostic_overhead: UNMEASURED; no future runtime or cost guarantee

acceptance_criteria: All0..810 covered with complete finite source-real residual/tube/event/background closure
Explicit state/output/initial/kernel/roundoff uncertainty and sup intervals
Checkable producer/checker artifacts and immutable input hashes; no changed model/selector
Historical trace and new reconstruction roles clearly distinguished
rejection_criteria: A false claimed certificate bound or wrong source/event semantics rejects that certificate; does not by itself falsify physical model
inconclusive_criteria: Any unbounded residual/event/background/output-map/terminal obligation returns exact first blocker
